list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Neodymium iodide disulfur-dinitride disulfide THF cluster

properties.summary: An absorption band was observed in THF solution; compound 1 was reported to be nonluminescent.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion; Fig. 1 and accompanying structural discussion
Results and discussion; UV-visible absorption and luminescence discussion
Supplied CCDC structures catalog row matching the Nd/ten-THF formula

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete trinuclear Nd cluster with an Nd–disulfide–Nd bicyclic fragment, a five-membered NdSNSN ring, and a three-membered NdNS ring. Ten of the fourteen non-carbon, non-hydrogen core atoms lie approximately in the Nd3 plane.

synthesis.procedure: Sulfur was added to neodymium iodide-nitride and THF in an evacuated Schlenk tube. The sealed tube was kept in an ultrasonic bath at 50 °C for 4 h. The starting iodide-nitride had been washed with THF at 60 °C (10 mL twice).
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed evacuated Schlenk tube; ultrasonic bath
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged, decanted the solution, and left it at −5 °C overnight. The crystals were separated, washed with cold THF, and dried under vacuum.

properties.summary: Upon UV excitation, compound 2 shows characteristic Dy(III)-centered luminescence with two narrow emission bands.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion; isomorphism of 1 and 2
Synthetic procedures; preparation of 2 by the method for 1
Results and discussion; Fig. 3 and accompanying spectral discussion

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete trinuclear Dy cluster is isomorphous with 1 and has the same iodide, disulfide, and disulfur-dinitride framework, including Ln–disulfide–Ln, LnSNSN, and LnNS cyclic fragments.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure for 1, using dysprosium iodide-nitride and sulfur in THF in a sealed evacuated Schlenk tube with ultrasonic treatment, followed by separation and cold crystallization.
synthesis.time: 4 h reaction; overnight crystallization (per procedure for 1)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed evacuated Schlenk tube; ultrasonic bath (per procedure for 1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifugation, decantation, overnight crystallization at −5 °C, cold-THF washing, and vacuum drying, as described for 1.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Isopropylamine-containing neodymium iodide disulfur-dinitride disulfide THF cluster

properties.summary: An absorption band was observed in THF solution; compound 3 was reported to be nonluminescent.

source_locations.location: Results and discussion; structural comparison with 1 and Fig. S2 reference

Results and discussion; UV-visible absorption and luminescence discussion

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete trinuclear Nd cluster has the same core as 1. Isopropylamine partially replaces a coordinating THF molecule; the reported composition averages 9.6 THF and 0.4 isopropylamine ligands per cluster.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as compound 1 in THF, except that the starting neodymium iodide-nitride was washed twice with isopropylamine rather than THF before reaction with sulfur.

reagents.name: Isopropylamine
reagents.role: starting-material wash and partially incorporated ligand

synthesis.time: 4 h reaction; overnight crystallization (per procedure for 1)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed evacuated Schlenk tube; ultrasonic bath (per procedure for 1)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Prepared and isolated as for 1 after the modified starting-material wash.
